item.title: Proimagenes Colombia: FDC 2026 Estimulos Automaticos
item.description:
Organisation: Proimagenes Colombia (Fondo para el Desarrollo Cinematografico)

Location: Colombia. Open to Colombian natural persons and Colombian legal entities only.

Award: Six automatic-stimulus lines drawn from the FDC's 2026 pool of roughly COP 21,900 million (around USD 5.5 million). The feature film promotion line alone carries COP 3,620 million. Amounts per award are set per line. No application fee.

Duration: Applies to activities taking place during 2026; automatic stimuli are awarded on qualification rather than by competition.

Deadline: 11 Dec 2026

The Fondo para el Desarrollo Cinematografico, created by Colombia's Law 814 of 2003 and administered by Proimagenes Colombia, channels at least 70 percent of its resources into film production. The automatic stimuli are the non-competitive strand: rather than pitching against other projects, applicants qualify by meeting defined criteria. Six lines are open for 2026, all closing 11 December 2026: film distribution in theatres, Colombian shorts and features selected for approved festivals, films nominated for approved awards, projects selected for approved industry encounters, individuals selected for approved training workshops and advisories, and promotion of national features or coproductions of at least 70 minutes premiering in 2026. A separate competitive strand (estimulos por concurso) runs 17 modalities on its own calendar. ELIGIBILITY IS RESTRICTED: Colombian natural persons and Colombian legal entities, though a Colombian company may have a foreign legal representative. Contact convocatoriafdc@proimagenescolombia.com.

Open call details

item.title: Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
item.description:
Organisation: Instituto Sacatar

Location: Itaparica island, Bahia, Brazil. Open to all nationalities.

Award: Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.

Duration: Approximately eight weeks; specific session dates are listed in the application.

Deadline: 28 Aug 2026

Brazil's longest-running artist residency, on the island of Itaparica across the bay from Salvador, hosting six to eight artists per session for roughly eight weeks. Open to all creative disciplines and, unusually for this region, to all nationalities, which makes it one of the few genuinely international residencies in Latin America. Sacatar provides full hosting (private room, three meals daily, individual studio, laundry, local logistics and connections) but explicitly does NOT provide a stipend, airfare to Salvador, art materials or discretionary local expenses, so applicants must fund their own travel. Individual artists only; group proposals are not accepted and former Sacatar Fellows may not reapply. COVID vaccination is required. NOTE: there is a USD 25 application fee. Apply through SlideRoom by 28 August 2026. Contact info@sacatar.org.

Open call details

item.title: Fundacion Klemm: 29th Premio Klemm a las Artes Visuales 2026
item.description:
Organisation: Fundacion Federico Jorge Klemm

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina. Open to Argentine nationals and to foreigners with at least two years of legal residence in Argentina.

Award: First acquisition prize ARS 7,000,000 (around USD 4,800), second prize ARS 4,000,000 (around USD 2,750). No entry fee; the foundation pays transport of selected works.

Duration: Single prize with exhibition; submitted work must be dated 2021 or later.

Deadline: 04 Sep 2026

The Premio Klemm is one of Argentina's longest-running visual arts prizes, now in its 29th edition, awarded by the Fundacion Federico Jorge Klemm in Buenos Aires. It is notable for a genuinely open definition of medium: the entry categories explicitly include arte digital, robotica, video, videoinstalacion, audio and fotografia alongside painting, drawing and sculpture, so technology-based practice is squarely in scope. Entrants submit one work dated 2021 or later, which must be durable rather than ephemeral. The top prizes are acquisition prizes, so winning work enters the foundation's collection. ELIGIBILITY IS RESTRICTED: Argentine nationals (native or naturalised) or foreigners holding at least two years of legal residence in Argentina, aged 18 or over. Submissions close 4 September 2026 at 23:59. Prize amounts and the closing date are stated in the bases y condiciones PDF linked from the entry site.

Open call details

item.title: Ambulante Gira de Documentales 2027: Call for Documentaries
item.description:
Organisation: Ambulante

Location: Touring documentary festival across Mexico (Mexico City, Queretaro, Michoacan, Morelos, Baja California and northwest Mexico)

Award: Selection for the touring programme. Free to submit, no entry fee.

Duration: Festival tour in 2027; work-in-progress selections must be completed by 19 November 2026

Deadline: Closed 03 Aug 2026

Ambulante's open call for its 2027 travelling documentary festival, which tours screenings across Mexico. Documentaries produced in 2025 or 2026 are eligible, and films may be finished or still in development: work-in-progress submissions are accepted provided the film is completed by 19 November 2026 and provisional viewing access is given in the registration form. Previous Mexican release does not disqualify a film, though unpremiered work is prioritised. SECTIONS: Pulsos, for Mexican documentaries over 60 minutes; and Coordenadas, for local productions from the participating regions (Mexico City, Queretaro, Michoacan, Morelos, Baja California and northwest Mexico) in feature, medium and short formats. Selected filmmakers must supply ProRes 422HQ or 4444 files at 1920x1080 or better, WAV audio, and SRT subtitles (Spanish subtitles are required for non-Spanish-language films; English subtitles are optional for Spanish-language films), plus director contact details and a press kit; DCP is optional for Pulsos. Submit through the online Airtable form; finished films need viewing links with passwords active through November 2026. Entry is completely free. Closes Monday 3 August 2026.

Open call details

item.title: Red Quincho: Beca Constelaciones 2026 (4th Edition)
item.description:
Organisation: Red Quincho

Location: Rotating urban and rural Red Quincho spaces across Argentina; residency runs September to December 2026.

Award: ARS 1,000,000 (around USD 690) per grant toward mobility, living costs and production, plus one month of lodging. 15 grants available. No application fee.

Duration: One-month residency split into two 15-day placements at different spaces.

Deadline: Closed 09 Aug 2026

Beca Constelaciones is Red Quincho's mobility and production grant for artists, curators and researchers doing territory-based work, now in its fourth edition. Each recipient spends one month in residence, split into two 15-day placements at different member spaces across Argentina, pairing an urban and a rural context. The grant covers mobility, living costs and production, with lodging provided. Backed by Fundacion Williams, CCEBA and Fundacion Santander through the CABA Mecenazgo scheme. ELIGIBILITY IS RESTRICTED: of the 15 grants, 13 are for people resident in Argentina and 2 are for people currently living in Spain. Artists, curators and researchers apply through separate forms; Spanish-based candidates face an additional jury evaluation. Deadline 9 August 2026 at 23:59 Argentina time.

Open call details

item.title: Fundacion Ama Amoedo Grants 2026 (4th edition)
item.description:
Organisation: Fundacion Ama Amoedo

Location: Open to applicants with a significant connection to Latin America, through nationality, cultural heritage, and/or the location where the project takes place.

Award: Ten grants of USD 10,000 each, awarded annually across four categories: Artists, Art and Social Engagement, Organizations, and Publications. No application fee mentioned.

Duration: Applications accepted via the online platform from 7 July to 9 September 2026.

Deadline: 09 Sep 2026

The Fundacion Ama Amoedo Grants provide resources and opportunities to strengthen the visual arts ecosystem and its institutions. Through an open call, ten grants of USD 10,000 are awarded annually across four categories: Artists, Art and Social Engagement, Organizations, and Publications. The program supports the realization of projects by artists, organizations, and institutions with a meaningful connection to Latin America. This is the 4th edition of the grants; the Foundation receives applications via its online platform from 7 July to 9 September 2026. ELIGIBILITY: artists, collectives, art professionals, non-profit organizations, institutions, and foundations with a significant connection to Latin America, whether through nationality, cultural heritage, and/or the location where the project will take place. Refer to the Terms and Conditions document on the website for full details. Inquiries: info@fundacionamaamoedo.org. Application deadline: Wednesday 9 September 2026, 11:59 pm.

item.title: ProAC / Fomento CultSP: Edital 05/2026, Electronic Games Development and Publishing
item.description:
Organisation: Secretaria da Cultura, Economia e Industria Criativas do Estado de Sao Paulo (ProAC)

Location: Sao Paulo state, Brazil. Open only to legal entities headquartered in Sao Paulo state for at least two years.

Award: BRL 300,000 (around USD 55,000 / EUR 50,000) per selected project, 20 projects total across two modules, from a BRL 6,000,000 pool. Registration is free.

Duration: Module I funds game development; Module II funds finalisation and publishing of an existing game.

Deadline: Closed 27 Jul 2026

Sao Paulo state's ProAC scheme runs one of the largest dedicated public funds for game development in Latin America. Edital 05/2026 splits BRL 6,000,000 across two modules of ten projects each: Module I for developing electronic games, Module II for finalising and publishing them, at BRL 300,000 per project. At least six of the ten slots in each module are reserved for applicants based outside the state capital. ELIGIBILITY IS RESTRICTED AND NARROW: individuals cannot apply. Applicants must be legal entities, meaning private companies (for-profit or not-for-profit) or registered MEI microentrepreneurs, headquartered in Sao Paulo state for at least two years, with artistic or cultural activity expressly stated in their founding documents. Applications close 27 July 2026 at 23:59:59 Brasilia time via fomento.sp.gov.br. Note this is a tight deadline.

Open call details

item.title: Beca Plataforma Bogota: Arte, Ciencia y Tecnologia 2026 (Colombia residents only)
item.description:
Organisation: Idartes / Plataforma Bogota

Location: Bogota, Colombia. Colombian citizens or foreigners legally resident in Bogota only.

Award: 4 grants of COP 12,000,000 each (approx. EUR 2,700) to run interactive art + science + technology labs at Plataforma Bogota. No application fee.

Duration: Labs run at Plataforma Bogota, the city's art-science-technology media lab.

Deadline: 24 Aug 2026

Plataforma Bogota, Idartes' art, science and technology media lab, awards four grants of COP 12,000,000 each to run interactive labs combining art, science, and technology. ELIGIBILITY: Colombian citizens or foreigners legally resident in Bogota only. Deadline 24 August 2026.

item.title: 41st Mar del Plata International Film Festival: Call for Entries
item.description:
Organisation: Festival Internacional de Cine de Mar del Plata / INCAA

Location: Mar del Plata, Argentina (festival 5-15 November 2026). Open to international entries; no prior public screening in Argentina.

Award: Selection in Latin America's only FIAPF A-accredited competitive festival (International and Latin American competitions, In Transit/WIP, Panorama). No submission fee stated on the registration page.

Duration: Festival 5-15 November 2026. Films completed November 2025 to November 2026.

Deadline: Closed 15 Jul 2026

The Mar del Plata International Film Festival is the only FIAPF A-list competitive festival in Latin America. The 41st edition accepts international entries across all genres for its International and Latin American competitions, the In Transit work-in-progress section, and Panorama. Films must be completed between November 2025 and November 2026 and not previously publicly screened in Argentina. Extended deadline 15 July 2026; submissions via the INCAA portal.
